title: Basics of Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing and Forms Selection
source: Income Tax Department, Government of India
content: Individual taxpayers file ITR forms annually based on income sources: ITR-1 (Sahaj) applies to resident individuals with income up to ₹50 lakh from Salary, one House Property, and Interest income. ITR-2 applies to individuals having capital gains or multiple house properties. ITR-3 applies to individuals with business or professional income. ITR-4 (Sugam) applies to presumptive business income under Section 44AD/44ADA. Normal due date for non-audit individual ITR filing is July 31 following the financial year. Mandatory e-verification must be completed within 30 days of ITR submission.
